_purpose: Job portals/boards to search directly for DevOps/SRE/Platform/Cloud roles, on top of the direct-ATS companies.json path. Used for Tier-B/C companies (no public ATS) and for catching postings from companies not yet in the registry at all.

tier1_bfsi_specialist._why: Purpose-built for banking/financial-services roles — the highest signal-to-noise for this specific search, unlike generic tech boards.

platforms.name: eFinancialCareers
platforms.access: HTML, has India-specific listings and search filters
platforms.why: THE specialist board for BFSI jobs globally including tech/infra roles at banks, hedge funds, asset managers, insurers. Search 'DevOps', 'SRE', 'Site Reliability', 'Platform Engineer' + India location filter.

platforms.name: iimjobs
platforms.why: India-specific, skews BFSI/consulting/senior-IC and management roles. Good for AVP/VP-titled tech roles at banks (remember: BFSI 'VP' often = mid-level IC, not literal seniority).

tier2_high_signal_tech._why: General tech boards with explicit experience/location filters — directly serve the <=5yr + India constraint without excess noise.

platforms.name: Instahyre
platforms.why: India-only, curated, product-company skewed. Explicit YoE filters.

platforms.name: Hirist
platforms.why: India tech-only, better DevOps/SRE/Cloud signal than Naukri, less noise.

platforms.name: Cutshort
platforms.why: India startup + mid-size hiring, has DevOps/SRE/Cloud category filters.

tier3_volume_generalist._why: Highest raw volume, highest noise. Mandatory for reaching companies with no public ATS (most Tier-C in companies.json) but every result needs verification against the actual employer.

platforms.name: Naukri
platforms.access: HTML / Apify actor recommended for scale
platforms.why: Largest India job-board inventory. Essential for Tier-B/C BFSI companies with no ATS API (Kotak, IDFC First, Razorpay career-page-only listings, etc.).

platforms.name: LinkedIn Jobs
platforms.access: Apify actor — scraping directly is ToS-restricted and IP-blocked
platforms.why: Broadest coverage, best location + experience + 'posted in last 24h' filters of any board. Reposts/expired listings common — verify against the employer before tailoring a resume.

platforms.name: Indeed India
platforms.why: Good secondary coverage where Naukri is thin, decent freshness filters.

platforms.name: Foundit (formerly Monster India)
platforms.why: Large India volume, decent BFSI presence, weaker filtering than Naukri.

platforms.name: Shine
platforms.why: Secondary India volume board, occasional BFSI-specific listings.

tier4_remote_and_gcc_specialist._why: For India-remote-eligible roles at foreign BFSI firms and GCC-specific hiring pages, where the parent boards above under-index.

platforms.name: Remote Rocketship
platforms.why: Filters remote roles BY country eligibility — avoids the 'remote but US-only' trap. Has India-specific pages for devops-engineer, site-reliability-engineer, cloud-engineer.

platforms.name: Wellfound (AngelList Talent)
platforms.why: Startup-skewed but has India + remote filters; useful for fintech scaleups not in companies.json yet.

tier5_salary_verification._why: Not job boards — used to sanity-check the 'Est. Salary Band (estimated)' column before it goes in the Sheet. All have thin samples for DevOps/SRE specifically; treat as directional, not authoritative.

platforms.name: Glassdoor India
platforms.why: Company + role salary reports, includes reviews (useful reputation signal too).

platforms.name: AmbitionBox
platforms.why: India-specific, often has more India-BFSI samples than Glassdoor for mid-size employers.

platforms.name: Levels.fyi
platforms.why: Best for large tech-adjacent employers (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) and global banks' India GCCs; thin for smaller NBFCs/insurers.

platforms.name: 6figr
platforms.why: India-specific comp data, decent BFSI GCC coverage.

apify_actors._note: Only worth the spend for Tier-B/C companies where the direct-ATS path (companies.json Tier A) and free HTML search both come up empty. Scope every run tightly — Apify bills per result.

recommended.query: DevOps Engineer OR Site Reliability Engineer OR Platform Engineer OR Cloud Engineer
DevOps OR SRE OR site reliability OR platform engineer OR cloud engineer
DevOps engineer OR site reliability engineer

apify_actors.cadence: weekly at most — daily broad queries re-pay for the same postings
